key_insight: This review chapter surveys laser processing across fusion, solar energy, electrochemical systems, and batteries; it is not specifically an AI solar-cell study.
engineering_relevance: Laser techniques offer routes to optimize photovoltaic cells, recycle solar modules, and improve battery manufacturing and electrochemical performance.
method: Review laser-driven fusion facilities and key laser parameters.
Survey photovoltaic optimization, concentrated solar power, and laser-assisted module recycling.
Examine multiscale surface texturing and laser processing for lithium-ion batteries.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a broad technology review but reports no quantitative results, datasets, or comparative benchmarks.
watch_item: Industrial scalability and performance benefits require application-specific validation beyond the overview provided in the abstract.
